def count_matching_rows(self) -> int:
        """Count the number of rows match (on overlapping fields).

        Returns
        -------
        int
            Number of matching rows
        """
        match_columns = []
        for column in self.join_columns:  # This will only iterate over the join columns, ignoring other intersecting columns
            if column not in self.join_columns:
                match_columns.append(column + "_match")
        return self.intersect_rows[match_columns].all(axis=1).sum()

def count_matching_rows(self) -> int:
        """Count the number of rows match (on overlapping fields).

        Returns
        -------
        int
            Number of matching rows
        """
        match_columns = []
        for column in self.intersect_columns():
            if column not in self.df1.columns:  # Incorrectly checks against df1 columns instead of join_columns
                match_columns.append(column + "_match")
        return self.intersect_rows[match_columns].all(axis=1).sum()
